intent: Let a Skill owner judge one immutable Version from its complete Run evidence before rerunning, revising, packaging, or publishing it.
observable_outcome: The exact Version workspace lists only that Version's Workspace-scoped Runs, keeps execution and evaluation distinct, and exposes truthful empty, loading, failure, in-flight, and pagination states.

acceptance_criteria.statement: GET /runs?skill_version_id=<id> returns only Runs whose immutable skill_version_id exactly matches within the Session-resolved Workspace, with filtering applied before limit and offset.
An invalid, absent-from-Workspace, or foreign skill_version_id produces an empty result rather than falling back to unfiltered Workspace history or leaking another Workspace's Runs.
When skill_version_id and test_case_id are both present, a Run must match both filters.
The exact Version page distinguishes loading, read failure, no Runs, in-flight Runs, terminal execution without a verdict, and evaluated Runs without treating execution success as acceptance success.
Every visible Run row links to the exact Run evidence and, when known, its Test Case while the page remains anchored to the current immutable Version.
The optional query parameter is backward compatible, generated clients remain current, and existing unfiltered and test-case-filtered callers keep their behavior.
